queries: WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price, AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_album_rate FROM album_rates) SELECT a.AlbumId, a.average_unit_price, a.bytes_per_millisecond, a.bytes_per_millisecond - o.average_album_rate AS rate_above_average FROM album_rates AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE a.bytes_per_millisecond IS NOT NULL ORDER BY rate_above_average DESC LIMIT 10;

WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price, AVG(Bytes * 1.0 / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_millisecond) AS average_album_rate FROM album_rates) SELECT a.AlbumId, a.average_unit_price, a.bytes_per_millisecond, a.bytes_per_millisecond - o.average_album_rate AS rate_difference FROM album_rates AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY rate_difference DESC LIMIT 10
